verdict.rationale: The Kimi help center lists '定时任务' (scheduled tasks) among its general features. That is the product's own documented capability for tasks that run without a live prompt, but it appears only as a single help-topic title. The editor 'automated tasks' and the agent-mode mentions describe in-conversation agent work, not background automations, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of how scheduled tasks are set up, whether they recur or run once, background or unattended execution details, triggers and limits, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
